entities.name: Marcus and Caius take their seats in the Volturi chamber
entities.description: Two members of the Volturi, Marcus and Caius, sit down in the ancient, domed chamber, assuming their positions as part of a formal proceeding.

entities.name: Aro approaches the rogue vampire in the center of the chamber
entities.description: Aro moves to the center of the room where a rogue vampire is kneeling, positioning himself to interact with the captive directly.

entities.name: Aro touches the rogue vampire's face with apparent compassion
entities.description: Aro places his hands on either side of the rogue vampire's face, displaying an expression that suggests compassion, before passing judgment.

entities.name: Volturi Judgment Session
entities.description: A formal gathering of the Volturi in their ancient chamber to pass judgment on a rogue vampire who has violated their rule of secrecy.
entities.summary: A formal gathering of the Volturi in their ancient chamber to pass judgment on a rogue vampire who has violated their rule of secrecy.

entities.name: Volturi chamber
entities.description: A domed room with an oculus in the ceiling, containing three large wooden chairs and occupied by vampires in 18th century attire, where the Volturi judgment session takes place.

entities.name: Aro
entities.description: A leader of the Volturi who approaches a rogue vampire in the chamber and touches his face, displaying an expression that might be compassion.
entities.summary: An ancient Volturi leader with mind-reading abilities, dressed in a black Italian suit, shows compassion and fascination toward Bella's immunity, influencing the Cullens' fate with authority and intrigue.

entities.name: Rogue vampire
entities.description: A feral and terrified vampire brought before the Volturi, kneeling in the center of the chamber as part of a judgment session.

entities.name: Carlisle
entities.description: A vampire who stands beside Marcus and Caius in the Volturi chamber during the judgment session.
entities.summary: A compassionate, golden-haired vampire who lived with the Volturi, aids Bella, subdues Jasper, and reflects on the moral implications of transforming humans, embodying a fatherly figure concerned with the soul's fate.

entities.name: Edward
entities.description: A vampire whose voice is heard in narration, explaining the role and rules of the Volturi.
entities.summary: A vampire with sparkling alabaster skin shares an intimate relationship with Bella, displays keen observation and wit, reflects on vampire nature, and discusses the Volturi, while navigating emotions about mortality and identity at school.

entities.name: Bella Swan
entities.description: A character whose voice is heard in narration, asking questions about the Volturi's purpose.
entities.summary: A young woman in Forks navigates emotional connections with Edward, Jacob, and her family, experiencing dreams, birthday moments, and supernatural influences while balancing relationships and personal reflections.

entities.name: Volturi
entities.description: An ancient vampire faction that acts as enforcers of the primary rule among vampires: maintaining secrecy about their existence.
entities.summary: An ancient, powerful vampire coven in Italy enforces secrecy and vampire laws, depicted as god-like rulers with refinement and violence, capable of ending vampire lives and posing a threat to others like Edward.

entities.name: wooden chairs
entities.description: Three large wooden chairs in the Volturi chamber where Marcus, Caius, and presumably other leaders sit during judgment sessions.

entities.name: Aro rips the rogue vampire's head off
entities.description: Aro violently removes the head of the rogue vampire in a swift and emotionless act during the Volturi judgment session.

entities.name: Felix and Demetri restrain the rogue vampire
entities.description: Two Volturi guards, Felix and Demetri, appear and hold the rogue vampire down to assist in the execution carried out by Aro.

entities.name: Volturi guards tear the rogue vampire limb from limb
entities.description: After Aro removes the rogue vampire's head, other Volturi guards proceed to dismember the body completely.

entities.name: Carlisle looks away from the execution
entities.description: Disturbed by the violent execution, Carlisle averts his gaze while witnessing the dismemberment of the rogue vampire.

entities.name: Felix
entities.description: A Volturi guard who assists in restraining the rogue vampire during the execution in the Volturi chamber.
entities.summary: A physically imposing Volturi guard with burgundy eyes assists in restraining a rogue vampire, follows the group through alleys, descends into the chamber, attempts to apprehend Bella, and releases Edward when ordered by Aro.

entities.name: Demetri
entities.description: A Volturi guard who assists in restraining the rogue vampire during the execution in the Volturi chamber.
entities.summary: A Volturi guard with burgundy eyes, part of the elite group enforcing order, assists in restraining a rogue vampire, follows Felix, and later leads Bella, Edward, and Alice out, interacting flirtatiously with Heidi.

entities.name: Volturi guards
entities.description: Enforcers of the Volturi who carry out the physical destruction of the rogue vampire after Aro removes his head.

document_metadata.title: 11、INT. CULLEN HOUSE - CARLISLE'S ROOM - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Edward reassures Bella of Alice's foresight and his ability to protect her, emphasizing her emotional importance to him, until Alice arrives abruptly, announcing an urgent development.

entities.name: Bella'S Birthday Party
entities.description: A surprise birthday gathering organized by Alice and attended by members of the Cullen family to celebrate Bella's birthday, featuring decorations, gifts, and a cake.
entities.summary: A surprise birthday gathering organized by Alice and attended by members of the Cullen family to celebrate Bella's birthday, featuring decorations, gifts, and a cake.

entities.name: Alice leads Bella and Edward to the living room for a surprise
entities.description: Alice excitedly guides Bella and Edward from the landing down to the living room, where a surprise birthday setup awaits with candles, flowers, and the rest of the Cullen family present.

entities.name: Bella reacts to the surprise gathering in the living room
entities.description: Bella is overwhelmed upon seeing the elaborately decorated living room and the group of Cullens gathered to celebrate her, expressing a desire to disappear due to discomfort with attention.

entities.name: Esme and Carlisle greet Bella with a warm hug
entities.description: Carlisle and Esme welcome Bella warmly with a hug upon her arrival in the living room, expressing affection and acknowledging the festive setup.

entities.name: Carlisle apologizes for the extravagant celebration
entities.description: Carlisle expresses mild regret over the over-the-top nature of the party, claiming they tried to restrain Alice but failed.

entities.name: Esme wishes Bella a happy birthday
entities.description: Esme warmly congratulates Bella on her birthday, contributing to the celebratory atmosphere despite Bella's visible discomfort.

entities.name: Alice takes a surprise photograph of Bella with the Cullens
entities.description: Alice uses a camera she found in Bella's bag to take an unexpected photo of Bella with the family, capturing the moment without prior warning.

entities.name: Emmett teases Edward about dating an older woman
entities.description: Emmett makes a joking comment to Edward about Bella being older, which Bella overhears, prompting Edward to elbow him to stop.

entities.name: Rosalie gives Bella a silver-wrapped gift
entities.description: Rosalie hands Bella a silver package containing a necklace chosen by Alice, then walks away with an air of disinterest.

entities.name: Bella and Jasper exchange friendly waves
entities.description: Bella notices Jasper across the room and they acknowledge each other with a wave, showing mutual recognition and cordiality.

entities.name: Edward embraces Bella on Alice's request

document_metadata.title: 121、INT. WOODS - MORNING
document_metadata.summary: Bella faces looming threats from the Volturi and Victoria, but chooses to become a vampire to stay with Edward, embracing their fate together despite Jacob's anguish.

entities.summary: A vengeful red-headed vampire, driven by the death of her mate James at Edward's hands, targets Bella to exact revenge, posing a threat that endangers Charlie and prompts fear for his safety.
